noticeBoard.intro: Documents for the whole season. A matchday's own notices — amendments, jury decisions, the protest list — are on its page:

live.text: Every boat on the map, the ranking of the race and the wind — from the sailors' phones.

pairing.title: Pairing lists
pairing.text: Who sails which boat in which race — balanced, printed, ready for the notice board.

results.title: Results
results.text: The race committee enters finishes on the water; points and standings follow by themselves.

live.title: Live tracking
live.text: Every boat on the map, from the sailors' own phones.

waivers.title: Liability waivers
waivers.text: Signed online by adults, on paper by a minor's guardian — and the check-in list knows.

expenses.title: Expense claims
expenses.text: Helpers file claims, the treasurer pays them as one bank file.

own.title: Your own event
own.text: An event need not belong to a league: a club creates its own and gets its own page.
